title: Trial Stryker.NET mutation testing in place of hand-run mutations
lead: Implementers in the DataBall relays mutate code by hand to prove each new test can fail: 79 mutations in db-09 round 1, 107 in db-10 round 1, 42 in a later round. This is slow model work, and in db-10 the implementer's mutation evidence could not be checked at all. Stryker.NET does mutation testing mechanically and writes a report that reviewers can read. This item is a trial on one recent slice's tests, to decide whether it replaces hand-run mutations in the relay.

**Owner gate:** Stryker.NET would be a new dev tool (a dotnet tool). The global rules require owner approval for any new dependency, and approval must come before installing anything. The licence (believed to be Apache-2.0) must be confirmed first.
findings_note: DataBall relays db-07 to db-10, owner 2026-10-10
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing the relay playbook (follow-up if the trial succeeds); CI integration.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner, 2026-10-10: offload model work to deterministic tools wherever possible. Hand mutation costs implementer tokens every round, and its evidence is only as reliable as the implementer's report.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Confirm Stryker.NET's licence, install method (a local tool manifest, never a global install) and supported .NET version. Bring this to the owner, and stop until approved.
2. Once approved: add a local tool manifest, run Stryker against the DetectionTests/FileTypeTests area (db-10) or ReadTests (db-08), and record run time, mutation score, surviving mutants, and noise or false survivors.
3. Write the result as a note on this item, with a recommendation: replace hand mutation, complement it, or drop the tool.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The owner approved the dependency before step 2.
- The trial result note exists.
- `slicer check`
